target:
def Target : Prop :=
  ∀ A : ℕ → Prop, REPred A →
    (∀ n, A n → ¬ ((Denumerable.ofNat Nat.Partrec.Code n).eval n).Dom) →
    ∃ k, ¬ ((Denumerable.ofNat Nat.Partrec.Code k).eval k).Dom ∧ ¬ A k
a_raw: {"translation": "Target is the proposition asserting that for every predicate A on the natural numbers (A : ℕ → Prop), if A is recursively enumerable (REPred A), and if for every natural number n such that A n holds, running the n-th code for a partial recursive function (Denumerable.ofNat Nat.Partrec.Code n) on input n does not halt, then there exists a natural number k such that running the k-th code for a partial recursive function on input k does not halt and A k does not hold. (In other words, every recursively enumerable subset of the non-halting diagonal set {n ∈ ℕ | the n-th code does not halt on n} misses at least one element k of that set; no effective/computable construction of k from A is required, and none of Def1–Def8 are used.)"}
